tina: opened PR #512 to refresh the quickstart hello flow — aim: single-file Python, clearer auth env var name, add tiny docker run example, and a short Node snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512
omar: nice. please call out that SDK v7+ expects REDWOOD_API_KEY and show Authorization: Bearer in curl.
lee: can we make the Python example literally one file (app.py) so it's copy-pasteable in the browser? also add PowerShell vs bash note for setting env vars.
tina: good points. i'll update the PR accordingly and move the Docker snippet next to the deploy step.
docs-bot: preview build queued for PR #512

docs-bot: preview ready  https://deploy-preview-512.docs.redwood.ai/preview (diff: quickstart consolidation, auth clarifications, docker snippet, node/python examples)
omar: quick wording tweak: change "set your key" -> "export REDWOOD_API_KEY in your shell". otherwise LGTM.
lee: LGTM, squash commits please.
tina: will squash & merge after CI. filing ISSUE #203 to expand troubleshooting appendix for CORS & local dev. merging when checks pass.
